subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose `agents.list[].description` as trimmed operator-authored text, or require an additional length/sanitization boundary before model-visible output?
rationale: The field is already accepted and preserved, but projecting arbitrary authored text into a model-facing tool response changes prompt size and metadata trust behavior; repository policy requires explicit ownership of that boundary.

options.title: Expose bounded metadata
options.body: Return trimmed nonblank descriptions with a documented maximum length and focused tests for omission and bounding.

options.title: Expose verbatim descriptions
options.body: Accept the linked pull request's trimmed-only behavior and document that config authors fully own the model-visible content.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Reject runtime exposure and document that descriptions remain human-facing metadata rather than an orchestration contract.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded metadata
recommendation.body: Return trimmed nonblank descriptions with a documented maximum length and focused tests for omission and bounding.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most strongly connects this person to `agents_list`, multi-agent routing, and the configuration boundary being extended.
